text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's up, City? Somethin' on your
mind? I'm
here to listen, so let it all out!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well... I was just thinking, I don't know
anything
about kids' fashion...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Clothes, huh? Well, I like sleeves that're
easy to
roll up so I can play in the sand.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why're ya askin' me 'bout kids'
clothes?! I
just wear a size small in adult
sizes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not what I meant. For my next
job, I
have to do styling on a kids'
photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Oh yeah, you have younger siblings.
What do
they usually wear?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Honestly, we give 'em the simplest clothes we can find. They'll only come home covered in mud anyways!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see... They'd do best in a natural
environment
where they feel
comfortable. But I don't wanna
get the
costumes dirty...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
City! City! You're overthinkin' it! You'll
scare the
tykes scrunchin' up your face
like that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Remember to smile! The kids will be
happy with
whatever ya pick for 'em as
long as you look
happy stylin' them! I'm
sure you're gonna get
some great
photos!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo... You're right. Thanks for the
advice.
